title: Network Administrator
description:
**Company Description** 
 SkyVector Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a fast\-growing engineering company specializing in advanced electronics, aerospace, defence, and electronic warfare systems, headquartered in Hyderabad, India. The organization designs and delivers cutting\-edge solutions for defence and aerospace programs, combining strong engineering capabilities with a culture of innovation. Teams at SkyVector work on indigenous product development across embedded systems, firmware, PCB design, and mission\-critical electronic systems. The company is focused on precision, quality, and solving complex engineering challenges that have real\-world impact. SkyVector is expanding across multiple engineering disciplines and offers opportunities to contribute to technology that matters.
 



  





**Role Description** 




  





**Why Join Us** 



* Work on real, mission\-critical hardware for defence and aerospace platforms — not simulations or academic exercises
* We're a fast\-growing company — compensation grows quickly with demonstrated performance, not just tenure
* Direct exposure to indigenous product development in a high\-technology environment
* Collaborative, hands\-on team



  





**Compensation** 




 As a startup, we're not able to match big\-company salaries right now — but we're growing fast, and early team members get real ownership over what they build, faster growth in responsibility, and compensation that scales quickly with performance rather than waiting on annual cycles.
 



**You should be someone who has actually administered a real network and IT infrastructure, not just studied networking theory** 
 . This posting is for a hands\-on network administrator, ideally with exposure to enterprise or secure technical environments.
 



  





**Minimum Qualifications** 



* **B.E. / B.Tech / Diploma — Computer Science, IT, ECE,**
* **2\+ years of hands\-on network/IT administration experience (real infrastructure managed — not academic or lab\-only projects)**



  





**What You'll Be Doing** 



* Managing and maintaining company LAN/WAN, network infrastructure, switches, routers, and connectivity
* Network monitoring, troubleshooting, access control, and system availability
* Supporting secure IT infrastructure suitable for defence/aerospace engineering environments
* User account, backup, and basic cybersecurity administration
* Working with enterprise networking and secure technical environments — preferred



  





**You Must Have Hands\-On Experience With** 



* LAN/WAN administration — switches, routers, firewalls, and access control
* Network monitoring/troubleshooting tools and backup/cybersecurity basics
* Enterprise or secure technical environments — strongly preferred



  





**To Apply** 




 Send your resume to c
 **areer@skyvector.in** 
 with subject line "Application for – Network Administrator". In your email body, mention your full name, total years of experience, Current CTC, Expected CTC, along with the size/type of network infrastructure you've personally managed (number of users/devices, environment) and one issue you resolved.

title: Cloud Network Architect
description:
**About**
 The Cloud Network Software Architect is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining our cloud\-based network solutions. This role involves working closely with cross\-functional teams to understand business needs and align the cloud network architecture to optimize performance, security, and scalability across Azure (primary), AWS, and private cloud environments.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design and architect secure cloud network solutions across Azure (primary), AWS, and private cloud environments.
* Treat network infrastructure as software — build reusable, version\-controlled IaC modules delivered through peer review, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Develop and enforce cloud network best practices, guidelines, and standards.
* Partner with other architects to define the technical strategy across the network and drive its execution with teams.
* Lead the use of automation to manage and maintain network infrastructure in public and private cloud environments, reducing manual toil across the estate.
* Leverage AI\-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality, and actively experiment with emerging capabilities as they evolve.
* Monitor network performance and implement enhancements to optimize for speed, reliability, and cost efficiency across public and private cloud infrastructure.
* Ensure network security in alignment with industry\-standard best practice — including firewalls, intrusion\-prevention systems, and encryption — and regularly assess and remediate vulnerabilities and threats using automation.
* Collaborate with application, infrastructure, and security teams to plan and deploy cloud\-based network strategies, and guide junior staff in troubleshooting and optimization.
* Create network documentation for design, configuration, and standard operating procedures; present technical strategy and network performance to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Stay current with industry trends, innovations, and best practices in cloud networking.


**What You'll Bring**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 15\+ years of experience in network architecture and design, with a strong focus on cloud environments.
* Proficiency in scripting and automation with Python or PowerShell, applying software engineering practices — version control, code review, and testing — to network automation, with strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Expert, in\-depth knowledge of Azure (primary) and AWS cloud platforms.
* Expert\-level cloud architecture knowledge, evidenced by Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert — or equivalent demonstrated experience designing enterprise cloud network solutions.
* Experience with networking protocols and technologies, and with network security practices and tools.
* Mastery of infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and CloudFormation.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate, for specialized Azure networking depth (preferred).
* Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE) or Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) (preferred).
* Excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders; strong teamwork, collaboration, and problem\-solving abilities; and a passion for mentoring others.
* Work flexibly as business priorities require, with availability for production\-impacting incidents or key customer events affecting network services.
* Ability to deliver work meeting all minimum requirements of quality, security, and operability.


**Leverage AI\-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality and actively experiment with emerging capabilities as they evolve**

title: Sr. Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Join Us as Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer!**
 ORBCOMM is seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to help design, build, and operate scalable, secure, and resilient cloud infrastructure that powers our global business and customer\-facing platforms. In this role, you will play a key part in advancing cloud modernization, automation, platform reliability, and operational excellence across our multi\-cloud environments.
   

  

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**
 As a member of our Information Technology \& Security team, you will partner closely with application, database, security, and DevOps teams to deliver reliable and secure cloud\-native solutions that support enterprise operations and customer experiences. Based in Hyderabad, India, you will contribute to the evolution of ORBCOMM’s cloud platforms across Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), helping drive scalability, resiliency, and innovation across the organization.
   

  

 This position is based in our Hyderabad office and will be working an onsite work schedule.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Cloud Infrastructure \& Platform Engineering**
* Design, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and OCI environments.
* Develop scalable, highly available, and fault\-tolerant infrastructure solutions.
* Support enterprise and customer\-facing applications with a focus on security, performance, and reliability.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to deliver cloud\-native infrastructure and platform services.
* Lead cloud modernization initiatives and infrastructure migration projects.


**Scalability \& Performance Optimization**
* Design infrastructure capable of supporting business growth and increasing workload demands.
* Perform capacity planning and develop long\-term infrastructure scaling strategies.
* Implement load balancing, auto\-scaling, high\-availability, and disaster recovery solutions.
* Conduct performance analysis across cloud and hybrid environments.
* Proactively identify and address infrastructure bottlenecks before they impact production systems.


**Automation \& Infrastructure as Code**
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code ( IaC ) solutions using Terraform and related automation tools.
* Automate provisioning, deployment, patching, and configuration management processes.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams to improve CI/CD pipeline efficiency and deployment reliability.
* Establish standardized, repeatable cloud infrastructure deployment patterns and best practices.


**Reliability, Monitoring \& Operations**
* Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability solutions across cloud platforms.
* Support incident response, service restoration, and root cause analysis activities.
* Drive continuous improvements in infrastructure resiliency, recoverability, and operational maturity.
* Participate in on\-call support and escalation processes as required.


**Security \& Compliance**
* Apply cloud security best practices across Azure, AWS, and OCI environments.
* Implement identity and access management controls, network security measures, and vulnerability remediation processes.
* Support compliance initiatives, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, and other applicable frameworks.
* Partner with security teams to ensure infrastructure aligns with organizational security standards.


**Who You Are**
 You are an experienced cloud infrastructure professional who thrives in complex, high\-growth environments. You bring deep expertise in cloud platforms, automation, and infrastructure engineering, along with a passion for building scalable, reliable, and secure systems that support business\-critical workloads.
   

  

**If You Have**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 7\+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, systems engineering, or cloud engineering roles.
* 5\+ years of experience supporting enterprise cloud environments.
* Strong experience with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and/or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
* Experience implementing and supporting large\-scale, highly available, and scalable cloud infrastructure.
* Proven success designing systems that support business growth, high transaction volumes, or global user bases.
* Strong networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, load balancing, routing, and firewalls.
* Experience administering both Windows and Linux environments.
* Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.
* Experience with monitoring, observability, and operational monitoring platforms.


**Preferred**
* Experience working in multi\-cloud environments utilizing two or more of the following: Azure, AWS, and OCI.
* Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or other containerized technologies.
* Azure and/or AWS cloud certifications.
* Experience supporting SaaS platforms and distributed applications.
* Experience with GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and automation frameworks.
* Knowledge of cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.
* Experience implementing disaster recovery and business continuity strategies.
* Leverage AI\-enabled tools and automation to support daily tasks and productivity.
* Commitment to continuous learning in digital and AI literacy.


**Then we want to** 
 meet you!
   

  

**The Benefits Of Working Here**
 A career with ORBCOMM offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and expand your expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment. Beyond being part of an exceptional team, we provide a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support our employees around the world. Benefits vary by location and include health and wellness coverage, paid time off, retirement or savings programs, flexible work arrangements, insurance coverage, lifestyle perks, and access to employee discounts—helping you thrive both professionally and personally.
   

  

**How We Hire**
 ORBCOMM uses technology\-enabled tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by people, as part of our human\-led, tech\-enabled culture.
   

  

**About Us**
 At ORBCOMM, we’re pioneers in IoT technology that drives innovation and empowers our clients to make data\-driven decisions. Our industry\-leading solutions enable customers to boost productivity, streamline operations, and increase their bottom line. With over 30 years of experience and the most comprehensive solution portfolio in the industry, we enable the management of millions of assets worldwide across diverse sectors, including transportation, heavy industries, satellite, and maritime. Discover how ORBCOMM is transforming industries and unlocking the potential of data to drive meaningful change at  www.orbcomm.com !
   

  

**Ready to Join Us?**
 We believe that our people are our greatest asset. Your skills and passion can help us achieve remarkable things! If you’re seeking a thrilling career opportunity in a vibrant, growth\-oriented environment, ORBCOMM is the perfect fit for you.
   

  

 We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and appreciate all applicants for their interest in joining our team. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
   

  

 At ORBCOMM, we are also dedicated to ensuring accessibility and are pleased to offer accommodations for individuals with disabilities upon request throughout all aspects of the selection process.

title: Services & Data Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About Beyond Key**
 We are a Microsoft Gold Partner and a Great Place to Work\-certified company. "Happy Team Members, Happy Clients" is a principle we hold dear. We are an international IT consulting and software services firm committed to providing. Cutting\-edge services and products that satisfy our clients' global needs. Our company was established in 2005, and since then we've expanded our team by including more than 350\+ Talented skilled software professionals. Our clients come from the United States, Canada, Europe, Australia, the Middle East, and India, and we create and design IT solutions for them. If you need any more details, you can get them at https://www.beyondkey.com/about.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 This role sits at the intersection of Platform and Data Engineering. You will be the primary custodian of our GCP environments, responsible for deploying, orchestrating, and securing not only our databases, but also the software systems and microservices that interface with them.
   

  

 Additionally, you will serve as our core GCP administrator, owning the full lifecycle of our cloud footprint. This includes provisioning new GCP projects, defining organizational hierarchies, and establishing enterprise\-grade security and permission boundaries.
   

  

 This is a highly autonomous, self\-managed role. We need an engineer who requires very little day\-to\-day management—someone who can architect infrastructure, write the necessary Terraform automation, secure the network perimeter, and safely deploy production\-grade software services, data platforms, and secure multi\-tenant GCP environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**GCP Tenant Administration, Software \& Service Deployment (Primary Focus)**
* GCP Project Provisioning \& Landing Zones: Own the end\-to\-end provisioning and lifecycle management of all new GCP projects. Establish, automate, and document standard "landing zones" (VPCs, Shared VPCs, logging buckets, and default security guardrails) for new application environments.
* Organization Hierarchy \& Governance: Manage the GCP Organization structure (Folders, Projects, Billing Account linkages) and implement Organization\-level policies to prevent misconfiguration or unauthorized resource exposure.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Own the end\-to\-end design, implementation, and management of Terraform configurations to provision and manage all GCP resources (Projects, Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Run, VPCs, IAM, Cloud Storage, and data systems) in a repeatable and modular manner.

**Required**
**Skills \& Experience**

Proven experience handling GCP Organization\-level administration, folder structures, project billing setups, and resource hierarchy management.

You will design scalable distributed training environments, model\-serving foundations, automation patterns and operational controls that align with client standards, SLAs, security, compliance and cost\-efficiency expectations. You will bring industry experience across enterprise AI adoption, cloud modernization, regulated workloads, FinOps and production reliability, while mentoring engineers and partnering with architects to translate business requirements into robust Azure\-based AI infrastructure solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Own end\-to\-end architecture and design of optimized Azure compute infrastructure for large\-scale AI/ML systems, including distributed training, GPU/accelerated compute, container platforms and model\-serving environments.

 Serve as an authoritative AI infrastructure expert on Azure, applying deep knowledge of Azure AI/ML services, accelerators, networking, security and cost levers.
   

  

 Develop and evaluate architecture alternatives, weighing trade\-offs across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, model serving, observability, security, compliance, cost and operational complexity.
   

  

 Lead architecture assessments and reviews of existing and proposed environments, identifying gaps, risks, bottlenecks and optimization opportunities, and recommending remediation actions.
   

  

 Drive architecture decision\-making by documenting rationale, trade\-offs, assumptions and dependencies so decisions are transparent, defensible and aligned with business SLAs and standards.
   

  

 Define and maintain AI infrastructure roadmap inputs, capacity planning models, scaling strategies, cost forecasts and performance improvement opportunities.
   

  

 Design deployment, automation and CI/CD strategies for reliable, repeatable and scalable releases of AI systems, models, data pipelines and platform components into production.
   

  

 Establish AI monitoring and observability practices across InfraOps and MLOps, including SLAs, SLOs, alerting, performance/cost tracking and continuous optimization.
   

  

 Integrate AI/ML systems into enterprise environments while ensuring interoperability, security, compliance, regulatory alignment and adherence to client standards.
   

  

 Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, architects and engineering teams to align infrastructure decisions with business outcomes and translate requirements into actionable architecture standards.
   

  

 Set technical direction for workstreams, mentor engineers, review designs/code and promote engineering best practices across the team.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related engineering field.
   

  

 Minimum 4 years of experience coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting, designing and operating AI/ML infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, model deployment pipelines or large\-scale engineering solutions.
   

  

 Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and the computing infrastructure required to deploy, run and optimize production AI workloads.
   

  

 Minimum 4 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C\+\+, Bash, PowerShell or equivalent engineering languages.
   

  

 Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, managed orchestration services or platform\-native workflow tooling.
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to work in a fast\-paced engineering or client delivery environment.
   

  

 Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder alignment skills.
   

  

 Minimum 4 years of experience in AI/ML infrastructure engineering or related roles on a hyperscaler or enterprise platform for deploying large\-scale solutions.
   

  

 Proven experience leading AI projects or engineering workstreams and managing priorities across multiple initiatives.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience evaluating and selecting AI technologies, frameworks, cloud services and architecture patterns.
   

  

**Required Skills/ Experience**
 Strong hands\-on experience with Azure AI infrastructure services including Azure VMs, AKS, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Storage, Azure NetApp Files, Azure Virtual Network, Entra ID, Azure Monitor and Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions.
   

  

 Experience architecting GPU/accelerated compute, distributed training, model serving, high\-throughput storage, container platforms and secure cloud networking.
   

  

 Strong working knowledge of Bicep/ARM/Terraform, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, InfraOps, MLOps, observability and incident response practices.
   

  

 Ability to optimize Azure AI infrastructure for performance, power, cost, scalability, security, reliability and compliance.
   

  

 Experience producing architecture decision records, reference implementations, standards, runbooks and reusable infrastructure patterns.
   

  

 Good to Have Skills
   

  

 Azure certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Azure AI Engineer or Azure Data Engineer credentials.
   

  

 Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail/e\-commerce, telecom, manufacturing, energy or public sector environments where AI infrastructure must meet compliance, security, reliability and cost\-control requirements.
   

  

 Exposure to LLM infrastructure, vector databases, retrieval pipelines, GPU scheduling, high\-performance storage, low\-latency model serving and model optimization techniques.
   

  

 Knowledge of enterprise architecture governance, FinOps, infrastructure partner/vendor collaboration and production support operating models.

 Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
   

  

**Overview:**
 Seismic is seeking an experienced, hands\-on IT leader to serve as the senior technical presence for our India offices. This is not a pure people\-management role — it is a high\-level systems administration position with a people\-leadership component. The Senior Manager, IT Operations will be the final escalation point for all technical IT issues in India, personally own day\-to\-day operations and troubleshooting, and lead a team spanning systems administration and helpdesk/support by doing the work alongside them — not simply directing others to do it.
   

  

 This role operates under Seismic’s India dual solid\-line operating model: the Senior Manager reports solid\-line to the Sr. Director, IT (functional direction, standards, and technical strategy) and solid\-line to the India GM (day\-to\-day people management, coaching, hiring within budget, and local escalations).
   

  

**Who you are:**
* 8\+ years of hands\-on IT systems administration, infrastructure, or end\-user support experience, including current, active technical work — not purely managerial.
* 3\+ years leading or mentoring a technical team, ideally spanning both systems administration and helpdesk/support functions.
* Working knowledge of core enterprise IT tooling: identity/SSO (Azure AD), MDM (Jamf and/or Intune), ITSM/ticketing (Freshservice or similar), major cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), and security tooling.
* A demonstrated track record as a doer — someone who resolves issues directly and leads by example, not someone who only delegates.
* Experience operating within a US\-headquartered multinational’s India office; SaaS or enterprise software company experience preferred.
* Comfortable operating in a matrixed, dual solid\-line reporting structure, balancing global functional direction with local execution and people leadership.
* Strong troubleshooting, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills under time pressure.
* Clear, direct communicator, able to escalate risk transparently to both local and global stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


**What you’ll be doing:**
* Serve as the final escalation point for all technical IT issues across Seismic’s India offices, spanning systems, network, endpoint, identity, and helpdesk\-tier issues.
* Own day\-to\-day IT operations for India — infrastructure administration, incident response, and end\-user support — personally diagnosing and resolving issues rather than only assigning them.
* Directly manage, coach, and mentor India\-based IT staff across both systems administration/integrations and helpdesk/support, setting the standard by leading from the front.
* Partner closely with the Sr. Director, IT and global IT functional leads to align India execution with global IT strategy, standards, and tooling (Jamf/Intune, Azure AD, Freshservice, Rapid7, 1Password, and similar).
* Own local hiring, performance management, and workload prioritization for the India IT team within approved budget, consistent with the India GM operating model.

* Identify and implement automation and self\-service improvements (Workato, Freshservice Service Catalog, AI tools) to reduce ticket volume and manual effort rather than defaulting to added headcount or process.

 This role goes beyond traditional support. You’ll operate at the intersection of
 **cloud engineering, reliability, and automation** 
 , owning the health of distributed systems running on AWS while driving operational excellence.
   

  

 If you enjoy
 **deep system visibility, proactive reliability engineering, and solving production\-scale challenges** 
 , this role is for you.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
**🚀 Cloud Reliability \& Platform Operations**
* Own and manage reliability of AWS\-based infrastructure (EC2, S3, RDS/Aurora)
* Drive best practices for resource management, tagging, and optimization
* Perform lifecycle operations on cloud infrastructure aligned to business needs
* Manage AMI strategies, backup readiness, and system recovery posture


**📈 Observability, Monitoring \& Incident Engineering**
* Leverage Datadog to proactively detect and resolve issues
* Build strong situational awareness across:
+ Infrastructure health (CPU, memory, storage)
+ Database performance and replication lag

* Act on alerts with a focus on root cause identification, not just resolution
* Improve alert quality, reduce noise, and enhance system observability


**🧠 Database Reliability Engineering**
* Ensure high availability and performance of Aurora/RDS clusters
* Monitor and optimize:
+ Replication and mirroring health
+ Query performance and database load

* Partner with engineering teams on performance tuning and resilience improvements


**💾 Data Protection, Backup \& Recovery Engineering**
* Own the integrity and reliability of enterprise backup systems (Commvault)
* Ensure backups meet strict SLA and compliance requirements
* Perform and validate restore operations (critical recovery scenarios)
* Continually improve backup validation, reporting, and audit readiness


**🔐 Security, Access \& Compliance**
* Manage certificates, access provisioning, and credential governance
* Support SOX compliance and audit requirements with precision
* Ensure all operations meet security and regulatory standards


**⚙️ Operational Excellence \& Automation Opportunities**
* Drive consistency through runbooks, SOPs, and process improvements
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive operational tasks
* Contribute to evolving the team from reactive support → proactive SRE culture


**💻 Core Skills**
**What Makes You a Strong Fit**
* Strong hands\-on experience with core AWS services, including EC2, S3, RDS/Aurora, and CloudWatch
* Deep expertise across AWS service domains:


* 
+ Compute: EC2, Auto Scaling, AWS Lambda
+ Storage: S3, EBS, EFS
+ Databases: RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB
+ Networking: VPC, Subnets, Load Balancers (ALB/NLB), Route 53
+ Proven ability to design and implement highly available, scalable, and fault\-tolerant architectures, including multi\-AZ deployments and disaster recovery (DR) strategies
+ Strong experience with observability and monitoring tools (e.g., Datadog preferred, CloudWatch, Prometheus/Grafana)
+ Hands\-on experience with backup and recovery solutions (e.g., Commvault), including DR planning and testing
+ Solid understanding of:


- 

* Distributed systems and reliability engineering principles
* Database operations, including replication, backup, restore, and performance tuning
* Experience working in production environments with high availability and critical uptime requirements


**🛠 Engineering Mindset**
* You think beyond tasks—focused on system reliability and resilience
* Strong troubleshooting skills with a bias for root cause analysis
* Comfort working in mission\-critical environments with real\-time impact


**🔄 Ops \+ SRE Balance**
* Experience in 24×7 production environments
* Ability to operate calmly under pressure while maintaining precision
* Interest in moving towards automation, efficiency, and reliability engineering practices


**➕ Nice to Have**
* Scripting experience (Python, Shell) for automation
* Exposure to ITIL, incident management frameworks
* Experience in regulated environments (SOX compliance)


**✅ Recommended Certifications (Preferred)**
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF\-C02\)
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate


**Why This Role Stands Out**
* 🌍 Work on business\-critical, high\-scale cloud systems
* ⚙️ Be part of a team evolving towards true SRE practices—not just operations
* 📊 Gain deep exposure to AWS, observability, and database reliability at scale
* 🚀 High ownership, real impact, and strong growth in Cloud \+ SRE \+ DevOps


 👉
 **If you’re passionate about reliability, enjoy solving real production challenges, and want to operate at scale—this is your role. Apply now.**

title: Wireless Implementation Engineer
description:
We are seeking
 **mid\-to\-senior\-level, hands\-on implementation engineers** 
 , not candidates whose experience is primarily architecture, monitoring, ticket escalation, or operational support.
 



 Ideal candidates should have:
 


* Approximately
 **5\+ years of hands\-on network engineering experience** 
 , preferably supporting a large, complex, 24x7 enterprise environment.
* Experience leading
 **end\-to\-end network deployments** 
 , including:
* Greenfield site implementations
* Legacy\-site modernization and architecture conversions
* Mergers and acquisitions integration
* Application and vendor connectivity deployments
* Subject matter expertise within their assigned technical area.
* Strong enterprise troubleshooting skills, including:
* Packet captures and protocol analysis
* Packet brokers and network visibility tools
* Root\-cause analysis
* Application connectivity troubleshooting
* Working knowledge of:
* DHCP and DNS
* RADIUS and TACACS\+
* LDAP and Active Directory
* Network access control and authentication services
* Ability to work directly with customers, application teams, vendors, security teams, architects, and other infrastructure teams.
* Experience working within formal change\-management and documentation processes.
* Ability to create implementation plans, network diagrams, configuration documentation, operating procedures, and operational handoffs.
* Clear written and verbal English communication skills.
* Healthcare or similarly complex, highly regulated enterprise experience is preferred.



  





**Wireless Implementation Engineer** 




**Primary Focus** 



* Design and implement enterprise wireless services for new and existing locations.
* Perform predictive, pre\-installation, validation, and post\-installation wireless surveys.
* Optimize wireless coverage, capacity, channel utilization, and roaming.
* Troubleshoot interference, dead zones, authentication failures, and client connectivity.
* Lead deployment, validation, documentation, and operational handoff.



  





**Must\-Have Experience** 



* Strong understanding of:
* IEEE 802\.11 standards
* Wi\-Fi 6, Wi\-Fi 6E, and preferably Wi\-Fi 7
* Radio\-frequency propagation and interference
* Channel planning
* Capacity planning
* Client roaming behavior
* High\-density wireless design
* Hands\-on experience conducting site surveys using tools such as:
* Ekahau
* Sidekick or similar RF survey equipment
* Spectrum\-analysis tools
* Enterprise wireless implementation experience with one or more major platforms:
* Cisco Catalyst Wireless
* Cisco Meraki
* Aruba
* Extreme Networks
* Experience implementing and troubleshooting:
* WPA2 and WPA3
* 802\.1X
* RADIUS
* Network access control
* Guest wireless portals
* Internet of Things segmentation
* Wireless roaming and authentication
* Ability to create wireless designs, heat maps, access\-point placement plans, implementation standards, and operational handoff documentation.

description:

**Responsibilities 职责**
 Lead the design, standardization, implementation, and management of global voice/telephony infrastructure.
   

  

 Liaison with operations team on voice service operations: monitoring/events, incidents, problems, and escalations.
   

  

 Define full lifecycle service management (roadmap, transition, operation, continuous improvement) for all voice/telephony hardware.
   

  

 Implement, coordinate and support telephony changes.
   

  

 Isolate, diagnose and resolve voice/telephony problems individually and through coordination with others.
   

  

 Maintain system access and security in order to safeguard company data.
   

  

 Work with various telephony providers on service deliveries, billing, maintenance, support and configuration changes for legacy PBX infrastructure, POTS lines, PRI lines, etc.
   

  

 Plan and perform Teams telephony migrations from legacy telephony setup
   

  

 Project contributor to other IT projects where and voice communication changes may be needed
   

  

 Assist with design of disaster recovery and business continuity plans
   

  

**Qualifications 要求**
 Demonstrated experience, including but not limited to:
   

  

 PBX telephone systems
   

  

 Cisco Unified Communications Manager and Voice over IP systems
   

  

 Teams telephony
   

  

 Teams based contact center solutions
   

  

 Teams admin center
   

  

 Cisco call center solutions
   

  

 Cisco Finesse
   

  

 Network protocols and standards, including TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, and VLANs
   

  

 Fundamentals of TCP/IP routing and WAN designs
   

  

 Industry certifications such as CCNP Collaboration, or equivalent
   

  

 Industry certifications such as Microsoft 365 Certified: Collaboration Communications Systems Engineer Associate, or equivalent
   

  

 Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex telephony issues
   

  

 Experience coordinating and working with teams of multiple disciplines globally
   

  

 Proven success of collaborating with non\-IT stakeholders
   

  

 Practical experience in IT infrastructure design, implementation and support
   

  

 Ability to document precisely and at right level of detail
   

  

 Ability to define and follow processes
   

  

 Ability to translate business requirements into IT solutions and associated cost
   

  

 Understanding of financial impact of decisions
   

  

 Ability to clearly define problem statements and determine solutions
   

  

 Must have strong planning skills
   

  

 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams
   

  

**Required Years Of Experience**
 \~ 5 years of designing, deploying, and supporting voice/telephony systems and networks
   

  

**Required Education**
 University or similar degree

description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Data Center Operations designs, installs \& maintains the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure. We are looking for skilled Data Centre Operation Technician at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”) with a passion for technology to help us expand AWS Cloud offerings to the next level.
   

  

 To keep up with this demand on both disk and network capacity, we continue to expand our Data Centers in India. Also, our content delivery AWS service, CloudFront, has expanded its Data Centers presence by over 50% worldwide in the last 12 months and are expecting to increase by a similar number over the next 12 months. This requires talented people to build \& manage. We hope it is you! Come and work for the world’s most Customer Centric Company. The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations.
   

  

 The Opportunity: Data Centre Operation Technician This role is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most advanced data centers in the world. ADSIPL’s data centers are large\-scale high\-density centers where you will be working on changing the face of Cloud technology in India.
   

  

 A Data Centre Operation Technician at ADSIPL, expectation from role are:
   

  

* You work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure.
* your role and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, server rack installation, hardware break\-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues also responding to emergent situations that affect operational stability.
* You may be the primary contact point for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Technical Operations) and external service partners (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).
* You will work and meet SLAs against assigned trouble tickets via a directed workflow, be the first line touch point for hardware troubleshooting and technical issues.
* You perform on\-call duties and will participate in Data Center operations, handling scheduled maintenance and change management activities that require monitoring of the data center infrastructure.
* You participate in team meetings for metric analysis and to discuss achieving daily/weekly goals.
* You possess knowledge of the policies and procedures, including safety and security, within your department, and understand the appropriate application of such knowledge
* You contribute to documentation on technical issues through root cause analysis for operational issues that occur, and contribute to process improvement initiatives relevant to the data center environment.
* More experienced technicians may assist in training less experienced members of the team.
* This position also has a physical component requiring the ability to lift \& rack equipment up to 18kg; it may require working in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health \& safety guidelines.
* This role involves covering 24x7 shift rotation

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Title:** 
**IT Disaster Recovery Manager**
**Experience** 
 : 8 to 12 Years
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 We are seeking a skilled and proactive IT Disaster Recovery (DR) Manager with 8–12 years of experience in IT infrastructure resilience and recovery planning. The ideal candidate will also have hands\-on experience in Planning and executing Disaster Recovery Exercies. This role ensures the organization's critical IT systems can recover rapidly and effectively in the event of an outage or disaster.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Primary roles and responsibilities:**
* Develop, implement, and maintain IT Disaster Recovery strategies, plans, and runbooks for critical systems and application services.
* Conduct regular risk assessments and business impact analyses (BIA) to identify recovery priorities.
* Coordinate and lead Disaster Recovery exercises, failover testing, and tabletop exercises.
* Work closely with application, infrastructure, and business teams to validate various recovery time objectives.
* Maintain documentation for DR procedures, policies, and communication plans.
* Monitor compliance with DR policies and industry best practices.
* Collaborate with vendors and cloud service providers for offsite DR solutions.
* Strong reporting and documentation skills to help develop materials on the action plans and provide status updates to senior leadership on the risks and dependencies associated with the action plans.
* Strong stakeholder management skills for international clients primarily based out of US and UK locations including prior experience in managing clients based out of the mentioned locations.


**Additional roles and responsibilities:**
* Collaborate with SMEs during DR drills to validate failover and integrity checks.
* Ensure alignment of database high availability (HA) and DR strategies.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalant in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Experience working at GSIB Bank (Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, Bank of America, Citibank, etc.
* 8–12 years of hands\-on experience in IT Disaster Recovery planning and testing.
* Exposure to industry frameworks such as ISO 22301, NIST SP 800\-34 etc.
* Certification preferred: CDRE, CBCP etc.
* Experience with DR tools and platforms (e.g., Veeam, Zerto, SRM, Commvault, Azure Site Recovery, etc.).
* Familiarity with backup and replication technologies.
* Experience in any of the Database technology i.e. Oracle, MSSql or MySQL.
* Understanding of virtualization (VMware, Hyper\-V) and cloud DR strategies (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Strong documentation and coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently and cross\-functionally.


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Relevant certifications (e.g., CBCP, CDRE, Microsoft/AWS/Azure certifications).
* Exposure to enterprise monitoring and alerting tools (e.g., Zabbix, Nagios, SolarWinds).


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Technical Manager - Network Operations
description:
Technical Lead \- Network Operations
   

  

 Hands\-on technical lead responsible for
 **advanced troubleshooting oversight,** 
 design , engineering
 **and strategic evolution with 12\+ years of experience in** 
 enterprise network across on\-prem, cloud, and contact center ecosystems. infrastructure lifecycle management, and country\-specific compliance requirements. This role acts as the primary escalation point for Hyderabad office network operations while closely partnering with Home Office infrastructure and security teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead and oversee Hyderabad office network operations and support activities.
* Manage and mentor local network team members and provide technical guidance/escalation support.


**Advanced Incident Resolution \& Escalation Ownership**
* Act as the primary escalation point for all network\-related incidents, outages, and operational issues.
* Lead resolution of critical P1/P2 network incidents
* Provide deep\-dive troubleshooting across:
+ Network (routing, switching, load balancing)
+ Cloud connectivity
+ Voice/contact center flows

* Perform packet\-level and call trace analysis
* Own final RCA and prevent recurrence through design/automation improvements


**Network Performance \& Upgrades**
* Monitor enterprise network for connectivity issues, performance degradation, and service interruptions.
* Coordinate with appropriate internal teams and vendors for issue resolution.
* Ensure timely incident response, communication, RCA, and closure.
* Manage on\-premises network infrastructure including:
+ Switches, routers, wireless infrastructure, and hub room maintenance.
+ Network hardware lifecycle activities include upgrades, refreshes, and replacements.


* Design and optimize:
+ Contribute to design and optimization activities in collaboration with Home Office teams:
+ Enterprise Networks (LAN/WAN, DC, Cloud) while aligning with global standards and architecture direction.
+ Hybrid cloud connectivity (Azure/AWS, VPN//ExpressRoute/Direct Connect) with active participation in planning, implementation and optimization discussions.


**Cloud Networking \& Hybrid Connectivity**
* AWS networking (VPCs, Transit Gateway)
* On\-prem ↔ cloud connectivity


**Load Balancing \& Traffic Engineering**
* Manage F5 load balancers (LTM, GTM concepts)
* Application delivery optimization


**Automation \& Observability**
* Develop automations for Incident response, Network validation \& Configuration management
* Enhance Monitoring (alerts, thresholds, dashboards), Observability (log/trace correlation)
* Drive MTTR reduction and predictive operations


**Vendor \& Platform Governance**
- Act as technical escalation point for vendors:

* ISPs / circuits
* Voice providers
* OEMs (Cisco, F5, etc.)
* Manage and maintain ISP connectivity including primary and secondary Tata circuits and coordinate with telecom providers for escalations and service restoration.
* Work closely with firewall/security teams on major incidents, network changes, and security remediation activities.
* Support and coordinate network\-related activities across both on\-premises and cloud environments.
* Provide oversight for Hyderabad Voice Operations team activities; no deep hands\-on voice administration required but expected to coordinate and drive operational accountability.
* Coordinate with Home Office teams on global initiatives, network standards, implementation plans, and operational improvements.
* Participate in major incident management calls and drive network\-related troubleshooting and resolution activities.
* Review and maintain network documentation, topology diagrams, SOPs, runbooks, and operational knowledge base articles.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve MTTR and reduce recurring incidents.
* Ensure monitoring, alerting, and operational processes are aligned with enterprise standards.


**Required Qualifications**
* Strong networking fundamentals across enterprise environments:

title: Zscalar/Zero Trust Security Architect - Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Zscalar/Zero Trust
   

  

 Consultant**
 We are seeking an experienced Zscaler Architect / Senior Engineer to lead and support the implementation, configuration, and migration of Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) solutions in enterprise environments. This role will help design and deliver Zero Trust access models, modernize remote access, and support migration from legacy VPN and proxy technologies. The ideal candidate brings strong hands\-on Zscaler delivery experience, solid network security fundamentals, and the ability to work across security, network, IAM, and endpoint teams.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Consultant on the Cyber team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Leading and supporting the implementation, configuration, and migration of Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) solutions.
* Assessing current\-state network and security architecture and designing Zero Trust access models aligned to business and security requirements.
* Planning and executing migration from legacy VPN, proxy, and remote access technologies to Zscaler platforms.
* Configuring ZIA and ZPA policies, application segmentation, connector deployment, authentication, forwarding methods, and user\-to\-application connectivity.
* Troubleshooting connectivity, performance, and policy issues and supporting pilot, rollout, cutover, and post\-migration activities.


**The team**
 Deloitte’s Cyber team helps organizations build, operate, and enhance security capabilities across identity, network, cloud, and application environments. The team works with clients to modernize security architecture, enable secure access, and support enterprise transformation through scalable, business\-aligned solutions. Professionals in this practice collaborate across cybersecurity, infrastructure, and technology stakeholders to address complex security and connectivity challenges.
   

  

**Location: Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Pune/Chennai**
**Shift Timings: Regular India Shift Timing**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 6\-9 years of experience in network security, cloud security, or enterprise security architecture.
* Experience implementing and migrating Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) in enterprise environments.
* Experience configuring ZIA security policies, including URL filtering, Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) inspection, authentication, forwarding methods, and access controls.
* Experience configuring ZPA application segmentation, connector deployment, access policies, and user\-to\-application connectivity.
* Experience integrating Zscaler with identity and security platforms, including Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), System for Cross\-domain Identity Management (SCIM), security information and event management (SIEM), endpoint detection and response (EDR), or cloud access security broker (CASB) tools.
* Experience with Domain Name System (DNS), Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP), routing, firewall policies, proxy technologies, and VPN migration.
* Experience creating technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, runbooks, migration plans, and operational handover materials.

* Experience designing Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) solutions and remote access modernization programs.
* Experience with Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) for experience monitoring and user troubleshooting.
* Experience deploying Zscaler Client Connector and integrating with endpoint platforms.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise transformation or network security modernization programs.
* Zscaler Certified Cloud Administrator (ZCCA), Zscaler Certified Cloud Professional (ZCCP) for ZIA or ZPA, or Zscaler Certified Cloud Specialist (ZCCS).

description:
**WHO WE ARE:**
 EOS IT Solutions is a Global Technology and Logistics company, providing Collaboration and Business IT Support services to some of the world’s largest industry leaders, delivering forward\-thinking solutions based on multi\-domain architecture. Customer satisfaction and commitment to superior quality of service are our top business priorities, along with investing in and supporting our partners and employees.
   

  

 We are a true International IT provider and are proud to deliver our services through global simplicity with trusted transparency.
   

  

**POSITION OVERVIEW:**
 We are seeking an Infrastructure Engineer to join our Audiovisual Engineering team. This technical role supports the global AV ecosystem that powers seamless communication and collaboration across the company. You’ll be responsible for the implementation, support, administration, and life cycle management of audio/video hardware and software, focusing not only on reliability, but also on automation, scripting, and operational scalability. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with commercial AV technologies (QSC Q\-SYS, Shure, Dante), video conferencing systems (Google Meet, Zoom), and converged IP networks, paired with a strong foundation in automation tools, programming, and infrastructure as code. You’ll play a key role in driving innovation, improving support processes, and building repeatable solutions that reduce manual overhead. This position involves full lifecycle project ownership—from requirements gathering and design reviews through deployment and operational support—and may require occasional off\-hours work.
   

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**
* Own the implementation and support of AV technologies for deployment projects globally.
* Work closely with architects, engineers, and AV integrators to design, automate, and deploy solutions that align with company standards.
* Develop and manage scripts, tools, and automation pipelines for provisioning and managing AV systems.
* Analyze, test, install, document, and support audio/video over IP solutions in a global, converged network environment.
* Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to support AV operations and upgrades in production.
* Produce scopes of work, documentation (including AV schematics), and vendor communications for new AV installations or retrofits.
* Identify and recommend new technologies or automation strategies to improve scalability and efficiency.
* Maintain detailed documentation of deployed AV configurations, including change history and versioning.
* Lead or assist in root cause analysis and long\-term resolution of AV issues; mentor junior engineers in troubleshooting and automation techniques.
* Develop and manage project timelines, resource estimates, and product refresh schedules.
* Serve as Tier 3 support for complex AV issues and escalations in production environments.
* Travel up to 20% for deployments, testing, and operational support.


**WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED:**
* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* QSC Q\-SYS certification, strong remote support experience
* 4\+ years in a corporate IT or AV integration environment, with at least 3 years working directly with commercial AV systems.
* Proficient in supporting video conferencing platforms such as Google Meet, Zoom, Logitech, and Neat.
* Programming and automation experience (e.g., Python, Ansible, PowerShell) to build tools and automate repetitive AV tasks.
* Strong understanding of AV over IP technologies and networking fundamentals.
* Experience with AV control system logic and user interface design is a plus.
* Comfortable adapting to change and working in fast\-paced, evolving environments.
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills, with attention to detail and a proactive mindset.
* Skilled in breaking down complex issues into actionable solutions.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills; capable of translating technical concepts for diverse audiences.
* Self\-starter with a passion for innovation, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Bonus: Experience supporting live production events or hybrid broadcast\-style setups.

**Infrastructure Automation Engineer (DevSecOps) – Azure, Kubernetes \& Terraform**
**Experience:** 
 6–9 years
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking experienced and hands\-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
   

  

 The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python\-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost\-awareness, and delivery quality.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
* Architect and operate production\-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self\-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
* Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform — module design, remote state, workspaces, policy\-as\-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
* Build, maintain, and optimize end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
* Develop Python\-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day\-2 operations across cloud platforms.
* Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy\-as\-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
* Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
* Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
* Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost\-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
* Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 6\+ years of overall experience in cloud infrastructure engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, or platform engineering, with at least 3\+ years in a senior or lead capacity.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps); working knowledge of AWS services (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudWatch) as the secondary platform.
* Deep, production\-grade experience with Kubernetes and the broader container ecosystem (Docker, Helm, Istio / service mesh, ingress controllers, operators).
* Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi\-environment patterns, and integration with policy\-as\-code frameworks.
* Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply\-chain controls.
* Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
* Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
* Good understanding of cloud networking, hybrid connectivity, load balancing, observability, logging, and access controls.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, deployment failures, distributed systems, and performance bottlenecks.
* Strong awareness of cloud governance, compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS Benchmarks), cost optimization, and operational best practices.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, collaboration, and stakeholder communication skills.


**Qualification and Certifications**
* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ\-104 / AZ\-305 / AZ\-400\), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security\+).
* Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.


**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Exposure to GCP and broader multi\-cloud operating models.
* Experience with policy\-as\-code and guardrails (OPA / Gatekeeper, Kyverno, Azure Policy, Sentinel).
* Experience with service mesh, GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Flux), and progressive delivery patterns.
* Experience with monitoring and observability stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, ELK, Datadog, or Dynatrace.
* Experience with Azure Cost Management, AWS Cost Explorer, tagging strategies, and FinOps practices.
* Exposure to platform engineering, internal developer platforms (IDP), release management, and SRE practices.


**Working Expectations**
* Collaborate effectively with architecture, engineering, security, application, and operations teams across geographies.
* Maintain clear, version\-controlled documentation for infrastructure design, deployment steps, SOPs, runbooks, and automation scripts.
* Demonstrate strong ownership in resolving issues, improving reliability, hardening security posture, and enhancing automation across cloud platforms.
* Follow enterprise delivery standards, security controls, change and operational procedures, and quality expectations.

* Expert\-level knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, PKI, LDAP, ADSI, clustering, domain services design, and enterprise directory governance
* Expert\-level experience with hybrid identity, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, endpoint management, Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager, and enterprise access management practices
* Advanced scripting and automation experience using PowerShell and related tools to design, deploy, govern, and operate repeatable enterprise engineering solutions
* Deep understanding of Windows Server, IIS, Hyper\-V, load balancing, LAN/WAN dependencies, shared storage, replication, and highly available platform design
* Demonstrated ability to design and govern high availability, disaster recovery, backup, recovery validation, monitoring, alerting, and service reliability practices
* Strong understanding of security, compliance, vulnerability management, privileged access, audit readiness, and regulatory frameworks including FedRAMP, SOX, HIPAA, PCI, and related reporting obligations
* Experience defining architecture, technical standards, support models, operational documentation, and governance practices across enterprise platforms
* Strong working knowledge of IT service management frameworks such as ITIL, including incident, problem, change, configuration, and service continuity practices
* Proven ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders, lead technical decision\-making, and translate ambiguous business or operational needs into scalable engineering outcomes
* Experience leading complex enterprise initiatives, mentoring senior engineers, coordinating customer\-facing or internal projects, and driving outcomes across multiple technical teams


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Responsible use of AI\-enabled engineering tools to improve documentation, automation, troubleshooting, operational analysis, and engineering productivity while maintaining governance and data protection standards

* Trusted technical judgment with the ability to balance reliability, security, cost, modernization, operational impact, and business outcomes

description:

 As an ADMS Delivery Manager you will be a pivotal contributor to the successful delivery of ADMS Series 3 (DMS / OMS / SCADA) implementations and upgrades for electric utility customers across the MENAT and APAC regions. You will own the technical delivery of assigned projects across the full post\-sales lifecycle – from requirements and design through configuration, network model build, testing, cutover, go\-live and hypercare – working directly with customers and with cross\-functional GE Vernova teams.
   

  

 This role is dedicated to the Distribution GSL Series 3 delivery portfolio and operates under the direction of the regional ADMS Lead in MENAT as well as the HTC GDC leader . It combines deep ADMS technical expertise with customer\-facing delivery ownership, and contributes to building regional capability and reducing reliance on single points of expertise. Requiring a high level of operational and technical judgement, the expectation for this role is moderate autonomy.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**
* Project Delivery Ownership
+ Act as the technical delivery lead for assigned ADMS Series 3 implementations, upgrades and installed\-base engagements across MENAT and APAC.
+ Own technical deliverables throughout the entire project lifecycle – requirements, functional and technical design, system configuration, distribution network model (DNAF) build and validation, integration, FAT/SAT, cutover, go\-live and hypercare – ensuring projects stay on track in terms of budget, time and customer expectations.
+ Plan and track delivery activities, effort and milestones for assigned projects; report progress, risks, issues and change requests to the regional Delivery Manager and project stakeholders.
+ Help to lay out proper staffing to cover all regional ADMS S3 deliveries and coordinate GE Vernova, HTC and partner resources assigned to the project to ensure all projects are successful.
+ Manage defects, change requests and technical actions through GE Vernova project tracking tools, maintaining accurate and auditable delivery records.

* Client Collaboration
+ Serve as the primary technical point of contact for the customer on assigned projects, explaining difficult or sensitive information and working to build consensus.
+ Work closely with clients to understand their unique needs and develop tailored delivery strategies through site assessments and workshops.
+ Make standard recommendations on workflow, application, interface, reports, testing and data uploads to customers during the implementation process.
+ Ensure go\-live readiness and provide support, including post\-live checkups, to guarantee customer satisfaction.
+ Travel to customer sites in the regions as required by project phase, including extended on\-site presence during testing, cutover and go\-live windows.

* Technical Expertise and Installed Base Support
+ Provide hands\-on technical support and troubleshooting across the ADMS Series 3 stack (Habitat / SCADA, DMS applications, OMS / Enterprise OMS, DNAF and system interfaces), including production issue resolution for installed\-base customers.
+ Support upgrade planning and execution for the regional ADMS S3 installed base, including version assessments, configuration re\-verification and migration activities.

+ Possess in\-depth knowledge of best practices and understand how your area integrates with others.
+ Have a working knowledge of the competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market.

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Computer Science or a related discipline from an accredited university or college.

title: Encryption Agility Engineer
description:
**Role Name: Specialist Information Security \- Encryption Agility Engineer**
**Job Posting Title:** 
 Specialist Information Security \- Encryption Agility Engineer
   

  

**Department Name:** 
 Trusted Core Technologies
   

  

**About Amgen**
 Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world's toughest diseases, and make people's lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what's known today.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Role Description:**
 The Specialist Information Security \- Encryption Agility Engineer will serve as a senior hands\-on engineer for Amgen's enterprise Encryption Agility Service for Post\-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) Readiness Preparation. This role supports the Senior Manager Information Security \- Encryption Agility Service Lead and the Senior Specialist Information Security \- Encryption Agility Team Architect by executing the technical work needed to build and operate Amgen's enterprise cryptographic inventory, discovery workflows, Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM), remediation tracking, and engineering guidance for encryption, cryptography, crypto agility, and post\-quantum readiness. The role is expected to be practical, technical, and service\-oriented, with the ability to analyze cryptographic findings across applications, cloud, infrastructure, identity, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), certificates, Key Management Services (KMS), secrets, data protection, Software as a Service (SaaS), and third\-party ecosystems.
   

  

 This position will translate architecture direction into working implementation tasks, data quality rules, dashboards, tool integrations, remediation tickets, secure patterns, developer guidance, and repeatable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). The engineer will partner with Digital Identity Access Service (DIAS), PKI and certificate service owners, Application Security, Artificial Intelligence (AI) Security, Enterprise Architecture, cloud, infrastructure, platform, Risk and Compliance, Procurement, Legal, Third Party Risk Management (TPRM), Operational Technology (OT), and vendor teams to help make Amgen's PQC roadmap measurable, actionable, and sustainable.
   

  

 The role is also expected to identify high\-volume, human\-intensive Encryption Agility Service processes and design Artificial Intelligence (AI)\-enabled orchestration patterns that reduce manual work, improve analysis speed, increase team throughput, and strengthen service consistency. This includes the ability to architect AI agents or coordinated teams of AI agents that support cryptographic inventory analysis, Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM) data quality, remediation tracking, reporting, evidence review, and governance workflows while maintaining human\-in\-the\-loop decision points for risk acceptance, exception handling, production change decisions, and other activities requiring accountable human judgment.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**
* Execute assigned Encryption Agility Service workstreams, including intake analysis, backlog execution, roadmap tracking, service metrics, reporting inputs, SOP updates, and service improvement actions under the direction of the Senior Manager and Principal Architect.
* Operate enterprise cryptographic discovery across source code, binaries, cloud key services, endpoints, file systems, network traffic, PKI and certificates, KMS and secrets, vendor attestations, Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) inputs, and Subject Matter Expert (SME) interviews.
* Build, maintain, and improve the Amgen CBOM using CycloneDX 1\.6\+ as the target format, including required fields, source systems, ownership attributes, quantum\-vulnerability status, remediation status, data quality checks, reporting views, and asset correlation.
