title: Cable Technician
description:
Job Summary
 



  





 We are looking for experienced and competent ELV / Data Center Technicians for deployment at AWS Data Center facilities in Hyderabad/Telangana.
 



  





 The selected technicians must be capable of working independently and consistently within a live, mission\-critical data center environment, strictly following site procedures, safety requirements, quality standards, and client/AWS compliance requirements.
 



  





 Candidates with previous AWS Data Center experience and/or a valid AWS Yellow Badge will be highly preferred.
 



  





  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Installation, termination, testing, troubleshooting, and maintenance of ELV and structured cabling systems.
 



  





 Installation and termination of fiber optic and copper cabling, including patch panels, racks, cabinets, and associated infrastructure.
 



  





 Fiber cable pulling, routing, dressing, labeling, patching, and basic testing.
 



  





 Copper cable installation, termination and testing, including Cat6/Cat6A or equivalent systems.
 



  





 Installation and maintenance of data center containment and associated passive network infrastructure.
 



  





 Perform equipment/rack\-related cabling activities according to approved drawings, method statements, and client procedures.
 



  





 Carry out troubleshooting and rectification activities independently.
 



  





 Follow all AWS site access, security, EHS, operational and compliance procedures.
 



  





 Ensure that all work is performed without causing alarms, service interruptions, damage, or operational incidents.
 



  





 Maintain high standards of workmanship, housekeeping, documentation, and site discipline.
 



  





 Coordinate with supervisors, engineers, and client representatives for daily work activities.
 



  





 Immediately report any incident, alarm, damage, safety concern, or deviation from approved procedures.
 



  





 Required Skills \& Experience
 



  





 Minimum 2–5 years of relevant experience in ELV, structured cabling, fiber optic, telecom, or data center projects.
 



  





 Hands\-on experience in fiber optic and copper structured cabling.
 



  





 Ability to perform cable pulling, dressing, labeling, termination, patching, and testing.
 



  





 Good understanding of data center working practices and mission\-critical environments.
 



  





 Ability to understand drawings, cable schedules, labeling standards, and work instructions.
 



  





 Must be capable of working independently with minimum supervision.
 



  





 Strong awareness of safety, quality, security, and operational compliance.
 



  





 Willingness to complete required background verification, AWS onboarding, training and badging processes.
 



  





 Previous experience working in AWS or other hyperscale data centers such as Microsoft, Google, Meta, etc. will be an advantage.
 



  





 Existing valid AWS Yellow Badge is a major advantage.
 



  





 Candidate Requirements
 



  





 Candidates should be:
 



  





 Based in Hyderabad or willing to relocate to Hyderabad.
 



  





 Available for a minimum 1\-year project commitment.
 



  





 Willing to work 48 hours per week and in shifts where required.
 



  





 Willing to work across different AWS facilities within Hyderabad/Telangana.
 



  





 Able to successfully complete all client\-required background checks, training, security and badging requirements.
 



  





 Disciplined and capable of strictly following data center procedures, particularly procedures relating to alarms, incidents and operational risks.
 



  





 Deployment Locations
 



  





 HYD120 / HYD121
 



 Vailkunta Tanda, Telangana – 501509
 



  





  





  





 HYD100 / HYD101
 



 Fab City Road, Hyderabad, Telangana – 501510
 



  





  





  





 HYD110 / HYD111
 



 Welspun Flooring Road, Telangana – 509217
 



  





  





  





 The primary base will be Hyderabad. Where deployment outside the agreed base location is required, applicable travel and accommodation arrangements will be provided as per project requirements.
 



  





 Preferred Certifications / Experience
 



  





 Preference will be given to candidates having one or more of the following:
 



 AWS Yellow Badge / previous AWS Data Center access
 



 Data Center structured cabling experience
 



 Fiber optic installation and termination experience
 



 Fluke testing experience
 



 OTDR / fiber testing knowledge
 



 Cat6/Cat6A termination and certification experience
 



 Relevant ELV / Fiber Optic / Structured Cabling certifications
